tasks.summary: Add registerWorkspaceCommands({ commands, consent, status, registrar, folders }): registers the durable insrc.workspace.register command (sc3) whose body resolves the primary root (folders()[0]), and runs the shared offerWorkspaceRegistration. Add offerWorkspaceRegistration({ consent, status, registrar, folders, prompts }): no root → no-op; already registered (state()) → no prompt; previously dismissed (prompts.wasDismissed) → no prompt; else ask a single sc4 ConsentGate prompt — on 'accepted' call registrar.register(root) once + push the outcome to sc2, on 'declined'/'dismissed' markDismissed(root) + write nothing (k4/lc1); on an accepted-but-register-fails path do NOT markDismissed (retryable) + push an errored status. Mirrors S002 registerDaemonCommands/offerDaemonInstall + S003 registerHostCommands/offerHostWiring.
